rules: TREE-AUDIT-006 — HIGH-RISK COMBINATIONS / PROVISIONAL GUARDRAILS: Normal additive percentage stat groups (ordinary + compatible permanent base stats) calculated once; skin multipliers 1/1.5/2 applied separately at end. Event-specific bonuses combine additively inside their named event category; explicit double/triple effects count as +100/+200 percentage points in that event group, not repeated multiplicative chains. Critical multiplier applies once to eligible hit, never rolls again on derived damage; DoTs use actual configured damage basis, cap per-source stacks as specified, snapshot damage at application, refresh at cap unless consuming stacks, no duplicate remaining-damage payouts. Proposed total simultaneous damage reduction cap 60%; temporary shields from independent sources cap at 50% recipient max HP overall except explicitly larger individual configured shield values; same named shield refreshes/replaces, not stack. Values are safety rails for simulation, not new approved balance caps. Prevent full-heal loops: no lifesteal from overkill, shield-only damage, or heal-derived damage; no proc recursion, one reward per actual kill. Distinct intended counter effects operate independently, attack counters increment per original completed attack not per hit/derived projectile. Hero special charge cannot bank casts, cap 100%, special-generated charges held until original activation completes; no immediate recast within 1s (proposed minimum). Necromancer on-death summons excluded from timed charges. Limit summon counts per owner using central configurable caps; suggested initial Hound cap 2 (Legendary Pack 4) and Undead cap 6 (Undead Legion 9), actual summon lifetimes/stats TBD. Every qualifying enemy death still triggers attempt to summon; if at cap replace oldest live owned summon, no death/expiry rewards for cap eviction. Do not silently forbid legitimate scheduled-wave kills by undead from triggering Raise the Fallen; summoned/dead allied units themselves never generate new undead, and enemy-created decoys excluded provisionally. Alpha/Death Knight replacement counts toward caps and does not add a separate summon. These caps/eligibility are untested proposals.

ECON-DESIGN-003 — SELECTED PACK PRICE AND CLASS ODDS. Each row: tier | standard pack coin cost | class (rarity, baseline probability). The rarity is an identity and pricing category, not a universal probability; probabilities specific to pack. No cross-tier pulls from standard packs.

ECON-DESIGN-004 — PITY: Track misses separately per pack tier for its rarest class (Mage, Barbarian, Priest, Warlock, Dragonkin; Barbarian selected over equal-odds Rogue due to rarity). After seven consecutive random draws of that pack without rarest class, the eighth guarantees that class. Reset streak on rarest random draw; persist through attempts/reloads, reset on voluntary prestige. Random constituent packs in boxes/mixed products count sequentially; guaranteed individual/Golden contents neither increment nor reset random-pack counter. No pity for skin deployment rolls. Explicit baseline odds shown to player plus guarantee rule; effective odds differ due to pity. This is a new delegated design choice, not original user-approved rule.

ECON-DESIGN-005 — STOCK: Three initial slots; ordinary Expanded Counter +1, Legacy Extra Counter and Larger Stall +1 each (max six). Always reserve one Recruit standard-pack slot, affordable given base cap 2; if more tiers eligible, reserve one separate standard pack of the newest current-run tier. Newest pack may be unaffordable but Recruit remains available. If any advanced products unlocked and eligible, guarantee one other slot as an advanced offer; otherwise normal random slot. Remaining stock rolls independent category then tier. Within eligible tiers t=1..k weights proportional to t, e.g. all five weights 1/15,2/15,3/15,4/15,5/15; no unlocked-tier bypass. Preserve anchors on rerolls while unsold; sold anchors never regenerate within an attempt. For advanced category guarantee draw from unlocked advanced weights renormalised; never force a locked product. Reserve/commission/contract/curated features apply to remaining eligible slots, merge guarantees where possible; priority Recruit, newest, Personal Commission, Contract Board, Curated Shelf, random advanced guarantee. If too few free slots skip lower priority, no extra free slots. Ordinary or permanent slot purchase during prep applies next restock, not immediate refresh.

ECON-DESIGN-006 — CATEGORY WEIGHTS FOR NON-ANCHOR RANDOM SLOTS (fully unlocked): standard 40%; individual 22%; double contract 7%; triple contract 4%; three-pack booster box 15%; Golden full-roster 7%; mixed 5%. Any locked/unavailable category transfers its weight to standard, not to other advanced products. Mixed requires at least two unlocked tiers, chooses first tier from normal weights and uniformly chooses distinct second eligible tier. Class for individual/double/triple offers uses corresponding pack's baseline class odds, without pity or consuming random draws. Multi-unit offers occupy one slot and deploy all contents at battle start. Draw each unit's skin independently (even guaranteed or duplicate classes); no forced Epic/Legendary skin in Golden packs. Golden refers to guaranteed distinct hero roster, not skin quality.

ECON-DESIGN-007 — INDIVIDUAL PRICES: if standard price b, Common max(1,b−1), Uncommon b, Rare b, Epic b+1, Legendary b+2. This preserves approved Common/Rare/Epic offsets and resolves Uncommon/Legendary. Recruit individual Knight 1, Archer 2, Mage 4; Outlaw Hunter 2, Barbarian 3, Rogue 3; Devotion Paladin 4, Nun 4, Priest 5; Occult Shaman 4, Druid 4, Warlock 5; Mythic Beastmaster 5, Necromancer 6, Dragonkin 7.

ECON-DESIGN-008 — MULTI-UNIT PRICES: double contract max(2,2i−1), triple max(3,3i−1), where i=individual list price. Prevent one-coin two-hero offer. Booster box 3b−1 (5/8/11/11/14 coins); Golden 3b (6/9/12/12/15 coins), premium of one over box for guaranteed diversity. Mixed b1+b2−1, distinct eligible packs. Existing discount unlocks apply at most one coin reduction per offer; minimum 1 per single, 2 per double/mixed, 3 per triple/box/Golden. No stacked discount, no negative/zero prices. One guaranteed first-pack discount cannot be used on individual or multi-pack offers. Haggler capped 45% per prep; permanent free and paid reroll counts unchanged, no sold-slot refresh. If reroll requested, persist rolled result and remaining reroll charges. No free purchase undo or refund for unwanted class; purchase contents resolved once, on committed battle entry, and saved against reload manipulation.

ECON-DESIGN-009 — COINS AND SHOP UPGRADES: max 2 + 2×completed class gates + 2×Reinforcements/Royal Funding owned + permanent Treasury bonuses up to 4, max 40. At maximum six slots, larger products enable buying more than six heroes, without multiplying slot count. Keep all 20 Legacy merchant effects and Shard prices except clarified product pricing and guardrails; do not add mandatory automatic slots, coin sinks or hero caps merely to spend every coin. Leftover coins lost except Frugal Victory's existing UP reward. Coin cap and stock capacity are complementary, never substitute either. Advanced upgrades need their existing Legacy prerequisites. Initial implementation should test accessible branches, not grant entire merchant tree at a given prestige.

COMBAT-BAL-006 — ENEMY ROW FORMAT: Stage | scheduled slots | basic HP / hit damage / speed | elite HP / hit damage / speed | boss HP / ordinary damage / speed. Preserve attack intervals, spawn count, speed, signature abilities and boss order from 7.1 unless specifically overridden here. Elite HP adjusted proportionally with basic HP; elite damage separately rounded design estimate, not individually simulated. Retain enemy base prestige multipliers ×1.08^p health/damage, ×1.02^p movement and attack rate, mutation ×2 HP/damage after scaling. Stage10 boss phase HP/damage defined separately. Distinct abilities still require full-engine tests.

COMBAT-BAL-007 — BOSS DETAILS: King Slime still splits at 50% into four normal 7-HP slimes; proxy effective 75.5 HP before scaling. Giant Plant root duration reduced from 2.5s to 2s, max two rooted, every 10s; actual impact untested. Stage10 rebirth phases 390/455/545 HP (total 1,390), ordinary hit damage 16/20/25, existing speeds and hit intervals 1.80/1.35/1.00s. Eldritch Rupture retains radii, cooldowns and telegraphs 1.6/2.3/3.0, 8/6/4.5s, 1/.9/.8s; damage 8/11/14 base retained (scale with prestige). Existing other enemy signature effects unchanged except use new ordinary hit damage where ability explicitly uses ordinary hit; Imp fireball now 6.5; Shadow Assassin backstab ordinary 11.25 +7. Root reduction and per-phase values not individually represented in aggregate simulation. Preserve first-ever stage attempt protection.

COMBAT-BAL-008 — HOLLOW LEGION: Choose small but threatening sequential bosses, rather than three additional full-sized stage bosses. Per-boss reference HP by stages 1–10: 30,34,45,53,61,77,85,101,110,127 (before prestige). Champion HP ×1.0, Sorcerer ×0.8, Executioner ×1.2, round nearest integer; combined ~3× reference. Champion ordinary damage 80% of stage boss ordinary hit, interval 1.6s, speed .65, shield absorbs first hit each 10s (no extra aggro). Sorcerer ordinary ranged magic 65% boss hit, interval 1.5s, speed .80, range 3.5; every 10s dark burst at target for 50% ordinary damage to other heroes in radius 1.2. Executioner ordinary damage 100% stage boss hit, interval 1.9s, speed .55, every 10s telegraphed heavy slam for 125% ordinary damage radius 1.5 after 1s warning. Use phase1 ordinary damage for stage10 faction reference (16); all scale with prestige. Distinct sequential encounters, 2s breaks, no parallel active bosses, original main boss remains last. Preserve reset5 even-stage eligibility and later frequency, 2 UP +1 Shard per faction boss, no class credit. These exact actor abilities and reference HP distribution are selected first-pass approximations to the simulated reduced pool, not separately simulated. No auto-heal or mandatory stage restriction.

COMBAT-BAL-009 — KEEP HERO BASE STATS: Base direct basic DPS across all fifteen remains 2.4–4.2. Distinct secondary effects/support provide additional value. Keep approved base HP, damage, APS, movement speeds exactly; Hound 9 HP, Undead 7 HP. Base ranges Knight 1, Archer 6, Mage 5, Priest 4; select Hunter 5.5, Barbarian 1.3, Rogue 1, Paladin 1.2, Nun 1, Shaman 4.5, Druid 4.5 normal/1.3 bear, Warlock 4.5, Beastmaster 2, Necromancer 4.5, Dragonkin 1.7. Ranges and movement geometry are baseline behaviour, never targeting/positioning skill upgrades. Special charge begins at 0 absent upgrades and charges while active; all 14 default 10s, except explicitly listed; cooldown means charge time from activation, no repeated cast bank; ready waits for valid opportunity. All numerical details here are selected implementation targets based on role budgets, not exact individually simulated ability interactions.

COMBAT-BAL-010 — DAMAGE AND CHARGE CLARITY: A base special value scales with applicable general/hero damage modifier and skin multiplier when derived from hero damage; fixed heal/shield values scale only with explicit healing/shield effects, %max HP based on final max HP. No double-count base damage when calculating percentage of normal attack. Basic secondary effects and status damage inherit original hero source; one actual final blow. Special rates, active duration, hit cap and geometry editable independently. Timed charge and attack counters retain 9.14 safety caps; use one cast counter per original activation, no derived proc recursion. Preserve approved explicit capture rescue mechanics; model omitted rescue, so actual outcomes may be easier with skilled manual intervention. No rescue upgrades. Tower remains 100 HP, 2 damage /3s aim, ordinary and permanent upgrades as reviewed.

ENDLESS-003 — ACCESS AND LOOP: First lifetime Stage 10 victory permanently discovers Endless and records campaign completion; actual entry requires Stage 10 cleared in CURRENT prestige run. Victory screen offers Continue to Endless or Return to Progression. Never automatically activate prestige or restart campaign. Each Endless run starts at Wave 1; before EVERY wave run existing preparation shop/deployment loop: full calculated tower HP, coin cap refill including all applicable run/Legacy bonuses, finite fresh stock, ordinary UP skill purchases, choose known spells, auto-open purchased packs and independently roll unlocked skins. All temporary heroes, summons, spell/ability charge, rescue counts and tower HP reset each wave exactly as a new campaign attempt. Nothing survives as a deployed army into next wave. Retain ordinary purchases, qualifying class kills, class coin-cap rewards and tier access across waves and across separate Endless runs within same prestige cycle. No unspent coin carry. Prior campaign victories cannot be farmed by reentering from Endless; return hub with Stage10 cleared state.

ENDLESS-004 — OUTCOME AND CHECKPOINT: Tower destroyed means current Endless run ends, no retry at same wave. Retain earned UP and Shards including valid kills on failed waves; persist highest completed wave and deepest attempted wave separately. Offer Start New Endless Run (Wave 1), Return to Hub, or normal voluntary prestige. Allow save/quit at intermission, resume same stock, purchases, state and wave index; no free reroll. A combat-active reload resumes identical committed state if reliable battle serialization exists; otherwise present Resume not supported for active battle, abandon that attempt/end run with already committed legitimate rewards, never grant fresh attempt at same wave. Confirm voluntary retirement; retirement ends run, no loss of earned rewards. Only one active Endless session per save. Legacy spending and skin-box purchases occur outside an active Endless run; ordinary UP purchases allowed at each intermission. Voluntary prestige terminates active session, uses existing highest main-stage payout capped at Stage10=15 Shards, resets ordinary progression and gates, never erases records, discovery, skins or earned permanent currency.

ENDLESS-005 — FAMILY ROTATION: Wave w>=1 uses existing family index f=1+((w−1) mod 10), in campaign order: Slime, Mushroom Man, Goblin, Bandit, Kobold, Zealot, Imp, Wraith, Cultist, Voidling. Reuse all their original mechanics, attack intervals, ranges, speed, visuals and eligible associated elites. Do not mix randomly selected families in v1.16.0, introduce unrelated random events, environmental hazards or new permanent skill mechanics. Family HP/count coefficients c=[0.80,1.00,0.55,1.00,1.15,1.15,0.75,0.95,1.10,1.25]. Normalized pre-prestige base HP = 33×c; scheduled slots N=min(120, round-half-up(80/c)+2×(w−1)). Base ordinary hit damage = 10.5×original family damage/Stage10 base damage (10.5) adjusted by floor 0.65 and ceiling 1.15, i.e. 10.5×clamp(original/10.5,0.65,1.15). This gives early archetypes meaningful post-campaign pressure while preserving distinctive fragile swarms and attack cadence; no new stage records or campaign stat changes. Scale elite HP by existing family elite/basic HP ratio applied to normalized basic HP, elite ordinary damage by original elite/basic damage ratio (zero remains zero), plus applicable wave/prestige scaling. Fractional values internal, round display only.

ENDLESS-006 — DIFFICULTY: Wave multiplier for enemy HP H(w)=1+0.04×(w−1); hit damage D(w)=1+0.025×(w−1); movement speed and attack rate both use S(w)=min(1.35,1+0.005×(w−1)). Multiply normalized base values by H or D and existing prestige factors 1.08^p for HP/damage and S×1.02^p for speed/attack rate. Separate attack interval inverse conversion, no multiply range/stun duration/fixed scripted mechanics. Count capped at 120, use existing three-part rising spawn pressure WAVE-PHASE-002 with all intervals ×0.85, lower interval floor 0.45s; no extra spawns on account of higher prestige except existing enemy-created summons. Wave-number scaling continues indefinitely; no wave cap or hidden forced loss. Use numerically safe representations; practical testing through waves 100/500/1000, protect from nonfinite values. All new exact stats/cadence outside pressure model are selected implementation proposals.

ENDLESS-007 — ELITES AND MUTATIONS: Respect existing prestige family unlocks (ELITE-PROG-001–004). Use completed prestige p and family-specific ceil(f/2) unlock, same quota min(18%,4%+3%×(p−unlockReset)) rounded, first 30% free from elites, family live caps 2/3/4; same elite replacement rule. Reuse persistent campaign family attempted flag, not a new first-ever flag on each Endless wave; successful current-run Stage10 implies all ten attempted. At p>=4, replace min(available basic slots,p−3) scheduled basics with mutants spaced through wave, ×2 HP and damage after scaling; never mutate elite or boss, normal reward exactly 1 Shard on each legitimate mutant kill even failed runs, no per-run farming cap. Enemy-created summons inherit applicable wave/prestige stats, no eligible UP/class reward, with original summon caps and no recursive scaling.

ENDLESS-008 — BOSSES: On every fifth Endless wave, after all scheduled minions and surviving hostile wave summons defeated, 2s break then one existing campaign boss. Boss family b=1+((w/5−1) mod 10) for boss waves: King Slime Wave5, Giant Plant Wave10, Orc Wave15, Bandit King Wave20, Drake Wave25, Seraph Wave30, Succubus Wave35, Lich Wave40, High Priest Wave45, Eldritch Horror Wave50; then repeat. Normalize each boss to effective 700 pre-wave/prestige HP, ordinary hit base 14×clamp(original ordinary hit/16,0.75,1.4); preserve existing attack cadence, speed, signature ability geometry/mechanics and relative phase damage; scale with H/D/S and prestige. For King Slime use effective HP = half initial boss HP + four normalized Slime child HP (26.4 each pre-multipliers), so initial HP=2×(700−4×26.4)=1188.8; split at half and destroy all four, one reward. For Eldritch Horror distribute 700 across phases in ratio 390:455:545 (196.40,229.14,274.46 approximately), same phases and original relative speeds/damage intervals; final phase death awards one boss reward. Boss signature damaging abilities scale with D and prestige once, not double. On nonboss waves clear all scheduled and lingering hostile units, then victory. Existing boss-created enemy reward exclusions remain.

ENDLESS-009 — FACTION: At completed prestige 5, every second boss wave (w=10,20,30...) receives the existing exactly-three sequential Hollow Legion encounters AFTER the minion wave and before that wave's original boss, one active at a time, 2s intermission. At p6 add boss ordinal j=1 mod10; p7 add j=3 mod10; p8 j=5; p9 j=7; p10 j=9, i.e. all boss waves at p10. No faction on ordinary nonboss waves. Each faction boss reference HP=12% of 700 (84) before H and prestige, Champion/Sorcerer/Executioner ×1/.8/1.2, ordinary damage relative to normalized boss per COMBAT-BAL-008, existing individual signature mechanics, apply wave/prestige factors once. Preserve legitimate 2 UP+1 Shard per faction boss; first campaign encounter rules unchanged. This precise smaller-boss budget is a design estimate; pressure proxy models faction as +15% normalized demand on every tenth wave at p5 only, not three literal encounters.

ENDLESS-010 — REWARDS: Eligible scheduled minions and elites retain cumulative 1 UP/6 kill rule and normal class final-blow credit, carry existing current-run remainder across mode transitions. +1 UP per eligible elite and +5 UP per normal Endless boss defeat; existing multipliers/milestones only as applicable, no repeat campaign first-clear journal reward. Existing mutation Shards (1 each) and faction rewards (2 UP+1 Shard per boss) remain unchanged even on defeat. New optional Endless bonus: exactly 1 Shard per normal boss defeat (every fifth wave), earned once per legitimate boss encounter including repeat runs; no extra end-of-run payout or exponentially escalating Endless Shard reward, no new currency. No UP/class credit for enemy-created units; faction bosses grant only their separate boss rewards, never scheduled-kill UP or class credit; preserve true final blow attribution for legitimate scheduled hero-owned kills. Normal boss Shard reward is independent of fixed 15 max main-campaign reset payout. Use unique persistent encounter/reward IDs and transaction commits against reload exploits, no cap on legitimate mutation farming. Existing one-Shard skin box and 570-Shard Legacy candidate unchanged.

CAMPAIGN-BAL-ROUND2 — Development branch revision supersedes conflicting original numerical targets: melee heroes with range <=1.7 gain 50% HP rounded and 15% basic damage; tower 3 damage every 2.5s; Stage 4 basic HP 11, damage 4; Small/Deep Treasury +2 coins each (total permanent Treasury +6 with Royal Treasury); campaign prestige payout original +2 capped at 15; failed campaign Stage 1 with at least one enemy defeated grants a minimum of 1 earned UP. Show total and any included top-up in battle report; no award on abandon/reload/debug or duplicate outcome. Carry remainder through attempts and mode changes, reset on prestige. Boss 5 UP, faction, class, mutation and minimum 2 UP rules retained. Prioritize progress on defeats, not win rate. Selected from two complete five-prestige engine campaigns; slower ten-kill alternative did not improve purchase pacing on the paired seed.

CAMPAIGN-PACING-003 — Ordinary scheduled-kill and elite UP base rewards scale by completed prestige: P0–3 x1, P4 x0.8, P5+ x0.65, including Endless. Existing earned income multipliers apply after scaling, class and knowledge bonus UP, boss UP, faction UP, mutation Shards and minimum 2 UP unchanged. Selected to curb later upgrade floods without reducing enemy difficulty. Radius-aware tower pathing and actual perimeter contact resolve navigation deadlocks without changing approved hero targeting upgrades or immunity rules.
